approach: Implement main(api) with phases: restore/observe, configure, approach/close, retention lift, transport, release/withdraw, verify. Fresh sensing identifies the cream-cheese carton and bowl; images suggest, but do not establish, a rigid-carton strategy. Five helpers suffice: observe(scope), candidates(measurements), lease(goal), check_effect(kind), and save_phase(). Use short api.drive leases, with individual api.control calls where features need refreshing. Checkpoint intent before motion and acknowledged jaw transitions before subsequent observations. Store identities, sparse reference geometry, tracker handles, dependencies and receipts in six keys capped at 8 KiB each; diagnostics retain twelve entries without nested histories. Resume the acknowledged physical phase, never initialization assumptions. Return completion_proposed and evidence, not claimed native success.
observations: observe uses api.state and fields-declared api.review, requesting at most 24 named points and three regions per review. Obtain tabletop, carton face/edges, inner bowl rim and visible cavity evidence. Inspect measurement_errors and dictionary membership before fitting; use api.camera/plane_point only with validated planes and genuinely visible boundary identities. Maintain table_plane, carton_envelope, inner_rim, cavity_evidence, patch_reference and hand_state with frame/camera provenance, residuals and componentwise uncertainty. Initialize api.track_init on identified carton texture before closure, saving its relation to the envelope. Validate track_update identity, inliers, spread, residuals and uncertainty_floor_m; use frame_id and reference_frame_id exactly. Preserve finite corner correspondences separately from same-body identity. Motion invalidates affected dependencies, not every stationary reference; occlusion or unknown registration supplies no movement estimate.
geometry: Use geo.plane's coefficients, geo.circle_xy only for a validated near-horizontal inner rim, and geo.rotation, transform, pad_position and attachment_error. Validate cuboid/support assumptions; retain uncertainty in unobserved thickness. Search two jaw axes, three lateral offsets and three contact heights sampled from geometry-derived feasible intervals, then three feasible release centers. Intersect opening-span, finger/support clearance and positive side-band overlap constraints using c+m-b <= t <= d-m-a, with 0<m<=min(b-a,d-c). Derive m jointly from available contact geometry and uncertainty, not an arbitrary margin. For entry, evaluate g = inner_radius - maximum carton-corner distance from bowl center; separately check vertical and finger envelopes. Report nominal slack, conservative slack over supported hypotheses, and actual trial effects. Preserve shared-error dependencies; heuristic tracker uncertainty is not calibrated confidence. Failed conservative slack triggers relevant sensing or another candidate, not an impossibility claim. A short-drop release does not certify settling.
gate_dependencies: Approach requires identified local surfaces and a locally justified path, not proof of the later transfer route. Closure requires measured side alignment and finger/support clearance; acknowledgment means possible holding only. A small retention lift requires locally justified clearance and a current patch reference, not retained-load evidence beforehand. Retention requires independently observed carton rise and agreement with measured hand motion via attachment_error. Transfer additionally needs the retained patch-to-envelope relation or a symmetry-invariant envelope. Release requires current footprint entry geometry, carton-bottom height near/above the rim, and clearance for opening fingers. Completion requires acknowledged opening, independently observed hand/carton separation, carton supported inside the cavity rather than bridging the rim, bowl stability, and consistent observations across withdrawal. TCP arrival alone passes none of these effects.
bounded_recovery: Every observer call site, including transit and postrelease, routes unknown through at most two informative followups: another camera, corresponding semantic landmarks, or a justified view move followed by fresh measurement. A new same-body patch supports a new differential test without global registration; envelope use still needs its measured relation or retained uncertainty. Limit execution to three grasp configurations, two placement corrections and one justified recoverable local trial when nominal feasibility survives conservative rejection. Never move through an observed obstruction. Unknown holding preserves closure; lower only onto an evidenced reachable support. Observed loss requires relocation and a newly justified grasp. After release, missing evidence prompts observation, not blind regrasp. Distinguish unknown, contradiction, loss, resource exhaustion and programming errors. Cap reviews at 20, reserving four for completion; cap motion decisions at 180, reserving 30 for recovery, and branch choices at eight. Check remaining budgets and route coverage whenever reducing progress legs.
jev_contract: Send program-derived phase, permitted candidates, measured geometry, uncertainties, slack and witness provenance, never imagined sensor facts. api.choose selects among at most three justified configurations plus observe/stop; each question explicitly names its subject, feature selectors and finite option meanings. Every physical update uses real api.control/api.drive. Supply exactly x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,gripper questions: increase/decrease/within_tolerance maps to positive/negative/hold for the explicitly selected world axis; gripper choices retain open/close/keep meanings. Jev answers dispatch unchanged. Bound leases to eight calls and refresh dependencies between waypoints. Derive tolerances from current effect slack, respecting supported floors; do not repeat a deadband-blocked correction unchanged. Record choices, acknowledged_steps and receipts; obtain full pre/post states separately because receipt before/after are position lists. Reached/stalled are controller outcomes. Independent reviews and measured object motion determine effects; failed checks include their numerical values.
